text: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend seven public members to City Council for appointment to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority (TRCA).

City Council on July 16, 17 and 18, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending July 16, 2023, and until successors are appointed: Ronald Chopowick Jennifer Drake Heidi Karst Maria Kelleher Basudeb Mukherjee Connie Tang Estair Van Wagner 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (June 24, 2019) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority.
